# Sapiens4

> Local AI coworkers for macOS 13+ and Windows 10/11. A free, source-available alternative to Grok Bot (GrokBot), with Codex as the main and preferred engine.

## Product facts

- Sapis collaborate through chat, specialist delegation, notes, tasks, automated routines, and computer access in CORPORA.
- The workspace and execution run on the user's computer. Default Codex model requests use OpenAI services; local does not mean offline inference.
- Windows supports ARM64 and x64.
- Community software is free for permitted uses under the Sustainable Use License, which is not an OSI-approved open-source license. Provider subscriptions, API usage, and relay hosting are separate costs.
- Codex CLI runs model calls. Consult the current configuration guide for supported model settings.
- Remote control setup is documented in docs/remote.md. An iOS or Android device, or another paired laptop or PC, can use the local workspace through a browser. The local computer must remain running and reachable. One paired remote device is supported at a time.
- Remote application content is end-to-end encrypted between devices through a relay, not a direct P2P network connection. The relay can observe traffic metadata. Users can host the relay and remote web app themselves; the web app host remains trusted. The preview is not independently security-audited.
- Sapiens4 is independent of Grok Bot and xAI.
